$comment: Single source for where the sample organization is made and what its files are called (architecture §11, 'Sample organization'). xtask (xtask/src/dataset.rs), the program bb-sample (crates/bb-sample/src/layout.rs) and the end-to-end tests (web/app/e2e/support/sample.ts) read it; nothing else names a folder, a file or the variable. The folders are relative to the work folder and use / as separator.
